definitions: A salt or ester of acetic acid, used in plastics, fibres, and other products.
A synthetic fibre or fabric made from cellulose acetate.
A transparent sheet of cellulose acetate, used for overhead projectors or as a base for photographic film.
examples: The film was made from cellulose acetate.
She was wearing a dress made of acetate.
The teacher used an acetate for the presentation.
